name: fold-on-purpose
problem: The fold-pressure round proved the round record is the last store a merge can still author: conflict markers in a charter pass for prose (check green with the conflict in the tree), merge=union auto-commits a schema-perfect chimera, the archive's own remint recipe re-stamps a fused seal, and a hand-fold re-grounds stressors across pins. Sessions.fold + marker-reading detection close rounds-fold-deliberately and the parallel-editing-discipline umbrella: every merged session state lands as one recipe-naming diagnostic, and the only path that merges round records is a verb that keeps both charters and refuses what it cannot keep true.

technology_stack.tech: Rust 2024; crates/archi: sessions.rs (new module: the fold verb — two-folder --into form, in-place marker-fused form, --keep, pin-match and seal rules, ## Folded trace), docs/mod.rs (pre-parse conflict-marker scan over archi/stress/ as recipe-naming E_SESSION; ## Folded section schema; two-open diagnostic names the verb), versions.rs (remint refuses marker-fused sessions; re-stamps a pending folded stamp, never a lineage-true one), main.rs (archi session fold dispatch + usage)
technology_stack.provenance: every change extends a proven seam: the marker scan mirrors index.toml's E_ARCHIVE recipe from make-the-join-safe, the fold writes through the same doc-line surgery as stamp_closed, and the verb ships e2e-tested in the same real-binary harness as remint

technology_stack.tech: git default merge boundary for archi/stress/ — deliberately NO merge attribute
technology_stack.provenance: fold-pressure lab falsified merge=union for prose stores: the fusion commits itself and validates; markers are the one honest detection surface

architecture_summary.role: owns the round-record join: reads the merged state, folds two rounds into one record with both charters kept, refuses folds across pins and untrue seals
detection: reads the merge boundary git draws — markers anywhere under archi/stress/ are one E_SESSION naming the session and the verb; validates the ## Folded trace forever

scenarios: mid-round same-slug merge: markers land in the charter, check names the session and the fold verb, session fold <slug> -m note normalizes in place (--keep picks the survivor), the round continues and the next save closes green with both charters in the record

sealed same-slug collision: E_ARCHIVE recipe keeps the first-landed entry, session fold preserves the surviving stamp and marks the folded stamp for remint, version remint -m note --session <slug> re-stamps the folded stamp — both rounds' records true on one lineage, remint refuses while markers remain

two open folders: E_SESSION names both and the verb, session fold <loser> --into <winner> -m note moves the stressors, keeps the loser's charter pin and stamp under ## Folded, deletes the loser folder, check green forever after
a fold across pins: the verb refuses and names the rule — a fold is only honest between rounds that pressed the same ground

tasks.description: the fold verb: two rounds into one record, both charters kept, refusals for pins and seals

findings-never-block: fold refusals are hard errors with recipes; check's session findings stay advisory except genuine structural breaks, exit codes unchanged for green trees
parallel-editing-discipline: e2e: the two-writer lab replays end to end — collide, fold, remint — and check closes green with both rounds' records intact on one lineage
rounds-fold-deliberately: e2e (session_e2e.rs): fold <loser> --into <winner> moves stressors, keeps both charters under ## Folded, refuses filename collisions, deletes the loser folder, and the survivor passes check
e2e: a marker-fused open pair folds in place; --keep theirs picks the surviving charter; the folded charter, pin and stamp are preserved verbatim
unit: fold refuses across differing pins, on mixed open/sealed pairs it cannot keep true, and on sessions with no fused or paired state
e2e: a fused sealed pair folds with the surviving stamp intact and the folded stamp marked pending remint; remint --session re-stamps the folded stamp and refuses while markers remain
unchanged-saves-close-rounds: save's close/stamp path is untouched by the fold; the version_e2e suite stays green
